title: House and tree
subtitle: A little house with a round roof, and a tree. 7 pieces, 5 steps.
note: Arranged as pictured in the manual on page 28 (steps and drawings are BinBuild's own). Piece list checked against the kit's confirmed inventory. Placements: x and y in studs, z in plates.

steps.text: Lay the long green plate flat on the table. That's the grass.
Leave one stud free at one end. Next to it, put an orange brick, then stack the other orange brick on top. That's the house.
Put the 2 black curved pieces on top of the house, tall ends together in the middle, so the roof hangs over both sides.
Put the grey round brick on the second stud from the other end. That's the tree trunk.
Put the green round plate on top of the trunk. That's the treetop.
